messages:
samantha.lee: @channel Support escalated a P2 from NimbleDocs — they see a sudden spike of 502/504s and p99 generation latency up to 12s starting ~13:00 UTC. Customer says retries >=3, affecting UI.

support-bot: Ticket #34278 created (severity P2) — https://support.redwood.com/tickets/34278 — assigned to eng-oncall.

kevin.cho: are we talking hosted or dedicated for that tenant? region?

samantha.lee: hosted, us-east-1, model=gptx-open-8q, routed through hosted-standard. Note: a canary rollout completed at 12:54 (deploy-bot reported success).

ops-bot: Canary deploy canary-2026-04-12 finished at 12:54:32 UTC (id: canary-20260412-78).

anirudh: looking at logs now — continuous-batcher backlog grows quickly; pending_batches in the thousands and queue_depth peaked ~9800 (limit 10000). Gateway shows upstream 502s with message "request_queue_timeout" rather than 429 early-reject.

mike.h: that suggests the queue is saturating because the batcher can't drain. Could be long-running work inside batches (kvcache/mmap). Any recent infra changes?

kevin.cho: only change I see is the canary (model runtime tweak). Could the model variant change tokenization/seq-len behavior?

anirudh: copying relevant excerpt from the worker logs (sanitized):
```
[13:02:10 UTC] batcher: pending_batches=1245 queue_depth=9800 tail_latency_ms=12345
[13:02:11 UTC] gateway: upstream_error=502 code=request_queue_timeout details="batcher_dequeue_timeout"
[13:02:12 UTC] worker[pid=2145]: kvcache_op=fetch key=tenant:nimbledocs:hotkey status=stalled syscall=mmap
[13:02:12 UTC] retry_controller: in_flight_retries=42
```

kevin.cho: looks like a KV-cache stall causing batch formation to be blocked. Batches wait on a hot-key read and backlog builds; gateway times out waiting on the queue.

samantha.lee: customer provided a repro payload. DO NOT RUN AGAINST PROD without QA — gist: long prompts (~2k tokens) mixed with many short prompts. Repro curl (redacted):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-open-8q","input":"<~2000 token prompt...>","max_tokens":1024}'
```

anirudh: I reproduced in staging by replaying their load (200 rps with mixed seq lengths). Staging shows workers stuck in mmap waits under high concurrency — continuous-batcher doesn't preempt the long op which blocks many slots.

mike.h: quick mitigation options: 1) route the tenant to a lower-concurrency / slim model-variant, 2) temporarily increase queue capacity (dangerous), 3) apply a per-tenant rate-limit to smooth burst. I can apply routing override if we agree.

kevin.cho: prefer routing override to a slim variant and per-tenant throttling. Don't increase queue cap for hosted without more testing. @mike.h can you implement the override and set TTL 30m?

mike.h: done — routing override applied for tenant nimbledocs -> gptx-open-8q-slim (tenant override id: ov-9087). TTL 30m. Notified support.

support-bot: Customer notified: temporary routing change to lower-concurrency variant applied; monitoring.

ops-bot: Alert channel muted for ticket-34278 by mike.h.

anirudh: after override p95 dropped from ~7.8s to ~1.4s within ~40s, queue_depth dropped to ~300. Some in-flight 502s persisted for a couple minutes due to retries.

kevin.cho: initial root cause hypothesis: canary adjusted the soft K/V eviction threshold or touched the kvcache path — causing expensive mmap-backed reads for hot keys. Those reads block the batcher for long enough that backlog forms and the gateway times out waiting on queue.

julia: I'll lead the RCA and customer comms. Proposed next steps: 1) revert canary to previous runtime variant pending root cause confirmation, 2) implement batcher preempt/hard-timeout for single-request stalls, 3) add kvcache stall metrics and an alert at 60% queue capacity, 4) add a staging repro harness that simulates hot-key kvcache stalls, 5) review per-tenant default routing policies.

kevin.cho: I'll cut a hotfix branch: batcher/preempt-short-circuit-2471. @anirudh can you own tests and try to reproduce flaky mmap behavior in CI?

samantha.lee: timeline for Support: initial customer report 13:00 UTC, mitigation (routing override) applied 13:05 UTC, observed stabilization baseline by 13:47 UTC. Customer wants an RCA and timeline for a fix.

julia: I'll draft the RCA and send to CS by EOD, and post the full postmortem to #postmortems once the technical RCA is done.

mike.h: follow-up: I also pushed a temporary tenant-level request-concurrency cap (10 reqs/worker) for nimbledocs to reduce tail amplification.

kevin.cho: long-term action items for eng-runtime: add preemption for batch assembly when a single request/kv-read exceeds X ms, and add circuit-breaker for kvcache slow ops.

samantha.lee: thanks all. Customer is happy with the mitigation for now. Moving to monitor state; will reopen if regressions occur. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident 34278 marked as mitigated at 13:47:01 UTC.

julia: I'll create postmortem doc and owner tasks in JIRA (PM-5012). Closing thread here; moving comms to #postmortems when RCA is ready.
